q: Reduced-error pruning replaces a subtree with a leaf when:
options: Accuracy on a validation set does not get worse
Accuracy on the training set improves
The subtree contains a numeric attribute
The tree is deeper than 3
explain: Pruning is judged on data held out from training, because training accuracy can only drop when pruning.

q: Why do we not use the test set to choose how much to prune?
options: The test set would then influence the model and no longer be a fair estimate
The test set is too large
Pruning cannot use labelled data
The test set contains no noise
explain: Keep the test set for the final check, and use a separate validation set for choices.
